title: Inzerva
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Heroes of the Realm characters)

paragraphs.text: Inzerva , known as the Master of Insights , is a blue / red aligned draconic planeswalker who gathers knowledge and jealously hordes secrets.

The character of Inzerva was created by Wizards of the Coast for a celebration card as part of the 2017 Heroes of the Realm program. They have shiny silver scales and is seen sitting a top of mountain of scrolls and books. One of their loyalty abilities creates a unique emblem that forces the opponent to play with their hand revealed and deals damage whenever they draw a card.
